optimization_protocol: fixed FEM-evaluation budget with no predeclared response target or target-based stopping rule
time_comparison_policy: every method: the same py11-estimated 25-point initial-FEM cost for its shared seed plus its recorded continuation wall time
confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval; unavailable for n=1
inference_policy: paired t-test for >=2 common seeds; otherwise Welch t-test only when both methods have >=2 runs; n=1 comparisons are descriptive
